limits: The custom preference fixture is synthetic and does not replace or modify the accepted Dolphin interoperability receipt.
The tested preferences were verified through the production audio-player Settings UI, source snapshot, IndexedDB commit, GCI export, browser reload and source relaunch.
The browser test does not establish audible fidelity or full-match gameplay accuracy.
Atomic storage protects committed generations; it cannot guarantee preservation of progress that had not completed a commit before a forced close.
